nif.rationale: A nighttime interference (RSS/NIF) study is required for a Class D station on 780 kHz (clear channel) and has not been completed. Nighttime compliance is NEVER inferred from daytime screening results. The station is a secondary (non-Class-A) occupant of §73.25 clear channel 780 kHz: the study must protect the dominant Class A station's skywave service, carries full clear-channel NIF complexity, and a DA-N (directional night) pattern is likely to be needed. Inputs: fcc_class, frequency_khz (channel-class membership), night_study_present.
